objective: Create the composition module app/service_app.py with a ServiceApp factory that wires the real JobStore, the worker (running the real renderer with the real shim), and the C1 handlers into one in-process service, so e2e can drive enqueue -> poll -> download without framework glue; own seam-defect fixes for T01-T04 (recorded as deviations).

concepts: composition root: the single place where frozen interfaces meet real implementations
lifecycle: start (spawn worker thread) / stop (join thread) must be deterministic for tests
integration-only fix ownership: patch a leaf for a seam defect only when the defect is on the seam, record every such patch

inputs: outputs of T01, T02, T03, T04 (the four leaf modules)

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf body {lang?: 'en'|'de'} -> 202 {job_id}; 404 {error} for unknown report; 400 {error} for lang not in {en,de}. GET /jobs/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int, error: string|null}; 404 {error} for unknown job. GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 with the raw PDF bytes as the response body (the bytes start with b'%PDF'; content-type application/pdf) when status is done; 409 {error: 'job not done'} while status is queued or running; 404 {error} for unknown job.

job record shape: {job_id: 'j<n>', report_id: string, customer_id: string, lang: 'en'|'de', status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int epoch, error: string|null, pdf_ref: string|null}. JobStore API: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get(job_id) -> record|None; mark_running(job_id); mark_done(job_id, pdf_ref); mark_failed(job_id, error); next_queued() -> job_id|None.

render_report_pdf(customer_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes — renders one PDF page per report of the customer, fetching report data exclusively via app/queries.py, labels from the C4 label tables for the given lang; returns a non-empty byte string starting with b'%PDF'.

allowed_dependencies.what: real shim + labels (passed into the renderer)
JobStore + worker loop (instantiated by the factory)
C1 handlers (exposed bound to the real JobStore)

non_goals: no fixes for non-seam defects (record and escalate to the owning leaf)
no persistence, no config files, no framework server
implementation_constraints: ServiceApp() returns an object with .handle_export_pdf(path, body), .handle_get_job(path), .handle_download_job(path), .start(), .stop()
.stop() joins the worker thread and must return within the test's patience (no hung thread)
any patch applied inside a leaf module for a seam defect is recorded in the checkpoint as a deviation with the leaf task id

acceptance_tests.description: ServiceApp().start(); handle_export_pdf({'report_id': 'r1'}, {}) -> 202; repeated handle_get_job reaches status 'done'; handle_download_job returns bytes starting b'%PDF'
ServiceApp().stop() after start returns within 5s (thread joined, no leak); a second start() works

failure_cases.scenario: seam defect in a leaf (e.g. worker expects renderer keyword 'lang' but C3 says positional)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: minimal patch on the seam line in the leaf; the checkpoint records the deviation with the leaf task id; the leaf's owned paths stay otherwise untouched

handoff.notes: the checkpoint must list every deviation (leaf patched, line, why) — T07 and the auditor read it; zero deviations is the expected green case.

warnings.detail: p80 (75-120 min) can exceed the stage leaf_p80_max of 90 min
warnings.rationale: seam defects discovered at wiring time are open-ended; if execution exceeds p80 the correct move is checkpoint_and_split around the single defect (the composition module itself is thin and stable)

warnings.detail: owns_fixes_for spans all four leaves; unbounded patching would defeat local recoverability
warnings.rationale: fix rights are limited to seam lines by constraint and recorded per deviation
